title: UNK-VQA: A Dataset and a Probe into the Abstention Ability of Multi-modal Large Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. The benchmark, UNK-VQA, measures the ability of multi-modal models to abstain from answering unanswerable visual questions.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
